SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY board.created_at DESC) AS rowNum, board.id AS boardId, users.user_id AS userId, users.nickname AS nickName, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId} AND board.user_id = follow.following_id ) AS isFollow, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM board_like boardLike WHERE boardLike.user_id = #{userId} AND board.id = boardLike.board_id ) AS isLike, board.title AS title, board.content AS content, board.like_count AS likeCount, board.shared_count AS sharedCount, board.comment_count AS commentCount, board.created_at AS createdAt, boardFiles.file_name AS boardFileName, profiles.file_name AS profileName FROM board board JOIN users users ON users.user_id = board.user_id LEFT JOIN profile_files profiles ON profiles.user_id = users.user_id LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND place LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.place}, '%')
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%'))
AND category = #{searchFilter.filter.category}
AND board.id IN (SELECT board_id FROM board_tags WHERE
tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
)
AND ( board.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR board.visibility = 'FOLLOW' AND board.user_id IN ( SELECT follow.following_id FROM follow follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId} ) )
AND board.created_at
< COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.dateCursor}, NOW())
> COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.dateCursor}, TO_TIMESTAMP('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
ORDER BY board.created_at DESC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.created_at ASC, board.id ASC
AND (board.like_count, board.created_at)
< ( COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.likeCursor}, 999999999), COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.dateCursor}, NOW()) )
> ( COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.likeCursor}, 0), COALESCE(#{searchFilter.filter.dateCursor}, TO_TIMESTAMP('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) )
ORDER BY board.like_count DESC, board.created_at DESC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.like_count ASC, board.created_at ASC, board.id ASC
LIMIT ${searchFilter.size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board board JOIN users users ON users.user_id = board.user_id LEFT JOIN profile_files profiles ON profiles.user_id = users.user_id LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND place LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.place}, '%')
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%'))
AND category = #{searchFilter.filter.category}
AND board.id IN (SELECT board_id FROM board_tags WHERE
tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
)
AND ( board.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR board.visibility = 'FOLLOW' AND board.user_id IN ( SELECT follow.following_id FROM follow follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT board.status AS status, board.visibility AS visibility, board.user_id AS userId, boardFiles.path AS path FROM board_files boardFiles JOIN board board ON boardFiles.board_id = board.id WHERE boardFiles.id = #{fileId}

SELECT board.id AS boardId, board.title AS title, board.content AS content, board.content_html AS contentHtml, board.travel_start_at AS travelStartAt, board.travel_end_at AS travelEndAt, board.status AS status, board.visibility AS visibility, board.category AS category, boardFiles.id AS featureImgId FROM board board LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' WHERE board.user_id = #{userId} AND board.status = 'DRAFT'

SELECT board.id AS boardId, board.title AS title, board.content_html AS contentHtml, board.travel_start_at AS travelStartAt, board.travel_end_at AS travelEndAt, board.like_count AS likeCount, board.shared_count AS sharedCount, board.comment_count AS commentCount, board.view_count AS viewCount, board.created_at AS createdAt, board.category AS category, board.user_id AS userId, boardFiles.id AS boardFeatureId, users.nickname AS nickName, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId} AND board.user_id = follow.following_id ) AS follow, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM board_like boardLike WHERE boardLike.user_id = #{userId} AND board.id = boardLike.board_id ) AS like, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board subBoard WHERE board.user_id = subBoard.user_id AND subBoard.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS boardCount FROM board board LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' JOIN users users ON board.user_id = users.user_id WHERE board.id = #{boardId}
